rules.paraphrase: Counsel is paid at the hourly rate in the assignment letter and not above it without an amended letter.

params.support_staff_rate: greater of 100 USD or 60 percent of the hourly rate

rules.paraphrase: Paralegals, law clerks and litigation support are paid at the greater of 100 dollars or 60 percent of the rate, never above 175 without consent.

keywords: research the Attorney General is better placed to do

rules.paraphrase: No payment for clerical work, training new attorneys, assignment set-up or conflict checks, or for services before the assignment letter.
Duplicative work, such as several attorneys billing for the same task, is not compensated.

params.travel_by_car: 100 percent of rate first hour then 50 percent

rules.paraphrase: Car travel time is billed at full rate for the first hour and half rate after, mileage is not reimbursed, and travel time cannot overlap other work.
Routine overhead, miscellaneous lines and unreceipted expenses are not reimbursed; any expense above 2,500 dollars needs prior approval.
In-house copying, faxing and scanning at actual cost not above fifteen cents a copy, itemised.
Invoices are monthly and not accepted for work more than 12 months old.
Each entry shows who did the work, the date, a detailed description and the hours.

unmapped_provisions.paraphrase: Invoices above 80 percent of the budget limit trigger a notice.
Budget limits and hourly-rate changes need an amended assignment letter.
